Digital Systems Architecture and Business Analysis

Digital Systems Architecture and Business Analysis introduces the ways organisations under-stand, evaluate, model and improve information systems.

Learning Objectives for this module:

+  Explain the role of information systems in organisations.

+  Identify appropriate system development methodologies for contemporary business needs.

+  Apply analysis and design methods to identify and specify information systems requirements.

+  Resolve inconsistencies from the application of different analysis and design techniques.
